name: No More Regrets
source:
You are to experience the aftermath of a calamity, being the only survivor of your village. What would your life lead you through? 

So! Accompany your father...figure? and face what's ahead, will you truly lead your life with no more regrets?

[From [url=https://k34loup.itch.io/nmr]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为村里唯一的幸存者，你将经历灾难过后的生活。往后的人生，又会带你走向何方？

那么！陪着你的父亲……或者说，像父亲一样的人？一起面对未来吧。你真的能让人生不再留下遗憾吗？

[摘自[url=https://k34loup.itch.io/nmr]itch.io[/url]]
